passages.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. Of David.
passages.sermon: David wrote this psalm.\r\nHe gave it to the choirmaster.\r\nHe intended it to be played with stringed instruments.

passages.text: Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He gave it to the choirmaster.
He intended it to be played with stringed instruments.
David speaks to God.
He says, “Hear my cry, O God.”
He asks God, “Attend to my prayer.”
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀ עַֽל־ נְגִינַ֬ת לְדָוִֽד׃ שִׁמְעָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים רִנָּתִ֑י הַ֝קְשִׁ֗יבָה תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃

passages.text: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
passages.sermon:
David is the speaker.
David is far from home.
David feels weak in his heart.
David calls out to God from distant places.
David asks God to lead him.
David wants God to guide him to a strong and safe place.
David asks God to bring him to a rock that is higher than he is.
passages.original: מִקְצֵ֤ה הָאָ֨רֶץ׀ אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֶ֭קְרָא בַּעֲטֹ֣ף לִבִּ֑י בְּצוּר־ יָר֖וּם מִמֶּ֣נִּי תַנְחֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.
passages.sermon:
God, You have protected me.
You have been my safe place.
You have given me shelter.
You have been a strong tower for me.
You have kept me safe from my enemy.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הָיִ֣יתָ מַחְסֶ֣ה לִ֑י מִגְדַּל־ עֹ֝֗ז מִפְּנֵ֥י אוֹיֵֽב׃

passages.text: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.
passages.sermon:
God, You are my protector.
Let me live in Your tent forever.
Let me find safety under Your wings.
You have heard my vows, O God.
You have given me the inheritance.
This inheritance belongs to those who fear Your name.
passages.original: אָג֣וּרָה בְ֭אָהָלְךָ עוֹלָמִ֑ים אֶֽחֱסֶ֨ה בְסֵ֖תֶר כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ סֶּֽלָה׃ כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ לִנְדָרָ֑י נָתַ֥תָּ יְ֝רֻשַּׁ֗ת יִרְאֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.
passages.sermon:
David is the king.
David asks God to give the king a long life.
He asks God to add days to the king’s life.
He wants the king to live for many years.
He asks that the king’s years last through many generations.
passages.original: יָמִ֣ים עַל־ יְמֵי־ מֶ֣לֶךְ תּוֹסִ֑יף שְׁ֝נוֹתָ֗יו כְּמוֹ־ דֹ֥ר וָדֹֽר׃

passages.text: May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him.
passages.sermon:
The king sits before God.
He sits there forever.
God, place your loving devotion over him.
God, place your faithfulness over him.
Let your loving devotion guard him.
Let your faithfulness guard him.
passages.original: יֵשֵׁ֣ב ע֭וֹלָם לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת מַ֣ן יִנְצְרֻֽהוּ׃

passages.text: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day.
passages.sermon:
David is the speaker.
David promises God something.
David says, "I will sing praise to Your name forever."
David says, "I will keep my vows every day."
passages.original: כֵּ֤ן אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לָעַ֑ד לְֽשַׁלְּמִ֥י נְדָרַ֗י י֣וֹם׀ יֽוֹם׃
